description: AICTIONBOT™ quantity and unit check by KULIC Advisory (tool 71). Takes order and goods receipt lines (order, item, ordered quantity and unit, received quantity and unit, unit price, optional lot size) and names the cause of every deviation from its fields: a different unit of measure with the probable conversion factor (red), over-delivery beyond the tolerance (red), a quantity rounded up to the lot size (yellow) or under-delivery (yellow), each with the amount where a price is given and the fix (tolerance, master data, return, chase the rest). Tolerance in percent, default 5. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. To match an invoice with order and goods receipt use match_documents. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: One row per line: order, item, ordered, unit_ordered, received, unit_received, price, lot_size. German column names work too (bestellung, artikel, bestellt, einheit_bestellt, geliefert, einheit_geliefert, preis, losgroesse).

name: check_quantities
title: Quantity and unit check: ordered against received quantity per line with the cause (over-delivery, lot size, different unit, under-delivery), the amount and the fix
